name: IntegrateIT Nanoleaf
notes: Control a Nanoleaf light (Light Panels, Canvas, Shapes, Elements, Lines) over the vendor's local Open API — on/off, brightness, hue/saturation color, color temperature, and effect selection by name — with documented power-button pairing that claims and stores the auth token for you, plus a configurable reachability poll that publishes POWER, BRIGHTNESS, HUE, SAT, CT, EFFECT, and DEVICE_ONLINE variables and fires on/off, effect, and online/offline events. LAN-only destination safeguard, the auth token never logged, and MAC-locked IntegrateIT licensing.
